description.zh: 与带宽包绑定的全球加速实例的ID。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance to which the bandwidth plan is attached.

description.zh: 与全球加速实例绑定的带宽包的ID。
description.en: The ID of the bandwidth plan to attach to the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

description.zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**。
description.en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

title.zh: 将带宽包与全球加速实例绑定
title.en: Attach a bandwidth plan to a Global Accelerator instance

descriptions.zh:
- **BandwidthPackageAddAccelerator**接口属于异步接口，即系统会先返回一个请求ID，但带宽包与全球加速实例并未绑定完成，系统后台的绑定任务仍在进行。您可以调用[DescribeBandwidthPackage](~~153241~~)查询带宽包的状态：
    - 当带宽包处于**binding**状态时，表示带宽包与全球加速实例正在绑定中，在该状态下，您只能执行查询操作，不能执行其他操作。
    - 当带宽包处于**active**状态时，表示带宽包与全球加速实例绑定完成。
- **BandwidthPackageAddAccelerator**接口不支持为同一个全球加速实例并发绑定带宽包。
descriptions.en:
- **BandwidthPackageAddAccelerator** is an asynchronous operation. After you send a request, the system returns a request ID, but the bandwidth plan is not yet attached to the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. The attachment node continues to run in the background. You can invoke [DescribeBandwidthPackage](~~153241~~) to query the status of the bandwidth plan:
    - If the bandwidth plan is in the **binding** state, the bandwidth plan is being attached to the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. In this state, you can only execute query operations.
    - If the bandwidth plan is in the **active** state, the bandwidth plan is attached to the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.
- The **BandwidthPackageAddAccelerator** operation does not support concurrent requests to attach bandwidth plans to the same Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga bandwidth-package-add-accelerator --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id gbwp-bp1sgzldyj6b4q7cx0000 --accelerator-id ga-bp1qe94o52ot4pkfn0000 --region cn-hangzhou
